mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invoice ( invoice_id, booking_id, shipper_id, basic_amount, discount_amount, adjustment_amount, total_amount, currency, billing_status, created_at, updated_at, version ) VALUES ( #{invoiceId}, #{bookingId}, #{shipperId}, #{basicAmount}, 0, 0, #{basicAmount}, #{currency}, #{billingStatus}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE invoice SET discount_amount = #{discountAmount}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId}
UPDATE invoice SET invoice_number = #{invoiceNumber}, payment_due = #{paymentDue}, billing_status = 'INVOICED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId}
UPDATE invoice SET paid_at = #{paidAt}, billing_status = 'PAID', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId}
UPDATE invoice SET billing_status = 'OVERDUE', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId}
UPDATE invoice SET paid_so_far = paid_so_far + #{paidAmount}, billing_status = 'PARTIALLY_PAID', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE invoice_id = #{invoiceId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM invoice WHERE billing_status = 'INVOICED' AND payment_due IS NOT NULL AND payment_due < #{now} ORDER BY payment_due
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice WHERE billing_status = #{billingStatus}
SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(invoice_number, 14, 4) AS INTEGER)) FROM invoice WHERE invoice_number IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTRING(invoice_number, 5, 8) = #{yyyymmdd}
